connections.action: 前速3–4.5；在下翻前把球中心移到窄梁轴线，不能把打开的轴套当边路。

connections.failureArea: open water below this junction; return toCP1

connections.failureArea: open water below this junction; return toCP1

timeConvention: All t in phase references are seconds on a global gameplay clock. Each stage may be launched on its stated repeat epoch after observing at boundary; no automatic segment clock reset. Witness arrival times assume specified speeds and do not establish real playability. Seesaw is event-driven and has no repeat epoch.

four-lift sets as grouped repeatable instances with deliberate phases

designedGradeSeparation.supportRule: No upper supports in protected lower prism. Span from Z>=4.2 to Z<=-4.2, soffit above9.8m; no pillar through lower lane or hammer gantry.
designedGradeSeparation.status: design reservation only; geometry/visibility not validated

assemblyNotes: All intra-stage connectors0..0.6m. A0.6m junction may contain.3m narrow tongue and2*.15m true seams, not.6m resting island.

Direct roller/flap/cross/lift connections must trim/reposition only decorative bearing covers if they project into named seam. Do not remove real support or assume whole existing GLB bounding box fits.
Shared-library support feet on high decks need local columns/piles down to ground outside lower-route protected prism. Do not float them in air or put broad hidden ground slabs.
Ramps are46/48degree short energy barriers following continuous serpentines; pending actual speed/contact verification, not inherited50degree evidence.
Only planned upper/lower crossing is recorded in designedGradeSeparation; drawing is not an automatic nonintersection certificate.

B04/B08 preceding45degree bridges widen only the boundary observation mouth to6.8m; other observation pads3.2m. Air seams are trimmed out of support within reported boundary centerline length, not extra travel.
